slides.title: Rx on the board. Stuck by round 3.
slides.body: They start at race pace, then spend the middle rounds standing over the bar.

slides.title: Check round one.
slides.body: If the first round already needs long breaks, the load is too heavy for today's workout.

slides.title: Drop the weight, keep the reps.
slides.body: Keep the movement and the rep scheme. Take 10 to 20% off the bar and keep moving.

slides.title: Swap the skill, keep the pattern.
slides.body: No toes-to-bar yet? Knee raises. Same trunk work, same pace, no standoff with the rig.

slides.title: Scaled and moving wins.
slides.body: Hitting the intended pace builds the fitness that gets you to Rx. Standing at the bar doesn't.
